description: Give a person or group (email_address), a domain, or anyone with the link access to a Drive file, as reader, commenter, writer (organizer roles on shared drives), with an optional expiry. Drive's email goes out only with notify: true, with `message` in it. Making someone the owner needs transfer_ownership: true. It changes who can open the file: do it only on the user's explicit go for this file and these people.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

discoverable.description: For domain and anyone: whether it shows up in search, rather than by link only.

file_id.description: The file's id, or its URL.

notify.description: Send Drive's email to the person or group.

name: share_file
title: Share a file
